name: Safeguard
description: Safeguard helps users inspect software supply chain risk from Claude, including vulnerabilities, SBOMs, findings, projects, components, policies, guardrails, compliance reports, remediation plans, SCM integrations, notifications, and organisation workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Safeguard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Safeguard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.safeguard.sh/mcp/anthropic.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Safeguard?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Safeguard in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
